name: propositions-projects
description: Umbrella marketplace for the propositions ecosystem — author-claim infrastructure for academic manuscripts (core) plus domain packs.

plugins.name: propositions
plugins.description: Author-claim ledger infrastructure: JSONL propositions, R1-R13 validator, audit chain, onboarding (Operation D scaffold) + extraction + manuscript-QA skills (clarity-audit / proofread / manuscript-audit). Supports ledger schema ≤ 1.6, incl. multi-file \input manuscripts.

plugins.name: tschema-check
plugins.description: Source-fidelity review for documents written from source material: three-layer method (sentence truth conditions, relations, logic) plus a validator that checks statements against the document and quoted evidence against the external source.
